使用声骸技能，幻形为游鳞机枢并进入格挡状态，格挡状态正常结束时挥砍造成{0}冷凝伤害。若在格挡状态下被攻击，则立刻反击，造成{0}冷凝伤害；若受到的为特殊技攻击，则会击破敌人的特殊技并进行反击，造成{1}冷凝伤害。
技能冷却：{2}秒

skill.descEnRank5:
Transform into a Lumiscale Construct and enter a Parry Stance. If you are not attacked during the Parry Stance, slash to deal 553.60% Glacio DMG when the stance finishes. If attacked, counterattack instantly, dealing 553.60%+276.80% Glacio DMG. When hit with a Special Skill attack while in the Parry Stance, break the Special Skill and counterattack, dealing 553.60%+276.80% Glacio DMG.

CD: 15s
